sentences.en: The actor used to have the tailor make his suits.
sentences.zh: 这位演员过去让裁缝给他做西装。

sentences.en: I agree with you that the actor is very talented.
sentences.zh: 我同意你的看法，这位演员很有才华。

sentences.en: I didn't know the actor until I saw the movie.
sentences.zh: 直到看了那部电影我才认识这位演员。

senses.zh: 演员（尤指男演员）,行动者,参与者
